description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Decagon builds a conversational AI platform for customer experiences. As a Member of Technical Staff, you will join an engineering team building and scaling the systems behind Decagon’s AI agents, from agent runtime and customer-facing products to infrastructure.
New-Grad Member of Technical Staff building AI agent systems for production

Responsibilities:
• As a Member of Technical Staff, you'll join one of four engineering teams building the systems behind Decagon's AI agents: Agent Engineering, Agent Orchestration, Enterprise Product, or Infrastructure
• Engineers here own their work end to end and are trusted to make a real impact from the start
• This role is for someone who dives deep into complex system challenges and builds elegant solutions that scale to millions of users
• The Agent Engineering team at Decagon deploys mission-critical AI agents to our customers that impact millions of users and directly drive Decagon’s growth
• You will build on our industry-leading AI agent platform, collaborate directly with customers and use your own creativity to devise long-term, scalable solutions
• Our mission is to deliver magical support experiences — AI agents working alongside human agents to help users resolve their issues
• The Agent Orchestration team builds the runtime and model orchestration layer that powers Decagon’s agents in production
• This is the orchestration layer that turns workflows, tools and guardrails into a reliable, low-latency, and delightful experience for end users
• The Enterprise Product team creates the platform that customers use to build, maintain, and improve their AI agents
• We transform complex engineering work into intuitive self-serve products, making sophisticated AI capabilities accessible to both technical and non-technical Customer Experience teams
• This team is core to Decagon’s ability to scale: the tools you build directly support agents for all our customers, each with unique workflows, data, and requirements
• The Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundations that power Decagon: networking, data, ML serving, developer platform, and real‑time voice
• We partner closely with product, data, and ML to deliver high‑scale, low‑latency systems with clear SLOs and great developer ergonomics

Requirements:
• This role is designed for candidates graduating between December 2026 and July 2027
• Pursuing or completing a B.S. (or higher) in Computer Science or a related technical field, graduating between December 2026 and July 2027
• Proficiency with Python, TypeScript, and asynchronous programming
• Track record of building and shipping high-quality products and features through coursework, internships, or personal projects
• Comfort digging into system failures across deep technology stacks using whatever tool the problem calls for
• Experience using AI coding agents as part of development
• Excitement to thrive in a fast-paced environment, continuously learn, and sharpen your skills

Preferred:
• Experience working with multi-modal models
• Experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, or production infrastructure
• 0→1 product-building experience
